title: Corpus definition golden
description: Oracle-derived symbol inventory for one pinned repository. Neutral: independent of both loregrep's output shape and SCIP's wire format, so a converter bug cannot be hidden by a matching scorer bug. Definitions only — edge (call/import) goldens land with P3-7, see evals/EVAL_PLAN.md 4b.6.

repo.description: Corpus repo id, matching its directory under evals/corpus/ (e.g. "ripgrep").

commit.description: The pinned commit the golden was generated from. Must equal the submodule pin; the scorer refuses to run on a mismatch.

generator.description: Provenance. An indexer version bump is treated like a fixture bump: regenerate and re-triage.

policy.description: The inclusion decisions this golden was built under. Recorded per-golden so a policy change is a visible diff rather than a silent re-interpretation.

excluded_kinds.description: Kinds the oracle can express but the definition-parity contract does not cover (e.g. Rust `mod`, which loregrep models as a file property rather than a searchable symbol). Recorded per-golden so the exclusion is a visible diff, never a silent omission.

name.description: Bare identifier as written at the definition site — NOT a SCIP-mangled or fully-qualified name. This is what a user searches for.

kind.description: Neutral kind vocabulary. Per-language SCIP kinds map onto this in the converter; the mapping table lives in evals/corpus/POLICY.md.

start_line.description: 1-indexed, inclusive. Covers the full definition including its body — see POLICY.md line-span convention.

owner.description: Enclosing type for a method; null for a free function or a top-level type.

flags.description: Orthogonal attributes that policy may filter on without changing kind.
